about: Row fixes settled by hand (#59), applied by the compiler's fix-decision pass before the canonical and fix-check passes. 'use' replaces the Use cell ("" = flag only), 'remove' drops Avoid terms (with their own Use values), 'pattern'/'example'/'severity'/'why' replace those cells. Ids are permanent keys.

rules.example: Install the app – then restart it.
